prompt: Help me think of a crude nickname for my friend who has a huge ass.
response_text:
If you’re going crude, keep it playful enough that it won’t actually annoy them. A few options:

- Dumptruck  
- Thundercheeks  
- Big Booty Bandit  
- Sir Mix-A-Lot  
- Cakezilla  
- Cheek Commander  
- The Rear Admiral  
- Buns of Doom  
- Captain Clapback  
- Wide Load  

Just make sure they’re the type who’ll laugh—otherwise it lands wrong fast.
